items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: He'd be on Canal Street, catching right in front of the Boston Club. Every evening, he'd be out there picking up nickels and dime. Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah. Now, he was a great drummer, too, at one time.

ctx.x: Remember his name? Huh? Remember? Henry Mahoney.
